project_type: React SPA (Vite 5) + Node.js/Express modular monolith + MongoDB/Mongoose
language: JavaScript (CommonJS on server, ESM on client)
build_system: npm workspaces via root package.json; server uses jest + cross-env; client uses vite + vitest
test_framework: Server: jest 29 + supertest 7 + mongodb-memory-server 10. Client: vitest 2 + @testing-library/react + jsdom
test_command: npm --prefix server test  (server) | npm --prefix client test  (client)
verification_instructions: 1) cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=test jest --runInBand  OR  npm --prefix server test  2) npm --prefix client test  3) npm --prefix client run build
environment_constraints: Windows (PowerShell). Use bcryptjs not bcrypt. Use cross-env for env vars. No shell-specific scripts.
contribution_requirements: Follow AGENTS.md strictly: no new libraries, CommonJS on server, correctOption never in responses, studentId always from req.user.id, AppError codes from errors.js, test names match TC-TEST-03 / TC-TEST-04, npm test must pass before PR.
key_patterns: routes → controller → service → model. asyncHandler wraps all handlers. ok(res, data, status) for responses. AppError('CODE') with codes from errors.js. validate({ params, body }) middleware. objectIdSchema from utils/objectId.js. helpers.js: createStudent, createAdmin, authHeader, createTestWithQuestions. Client tests mock api/* module (never the network), use MemoryRouter, vi.mock at module level.
directory_structure: server/src/modules/aptitude/ — service/controller/schemas/routes for M4. server/src/models/ — Mongoose models, barrel in index.js. server/tests/ — one *.test.js per area, setup.js + helpers.js. client/src/pages/ — one file per screen. client/src/api/ — one file per module. client/src/components/ — shared UI.
